errors.text_span: 另一条是红色实线，代表验证集
errors.evidence: The line representing the validation set (Valid) is orange, not red.

errors.text_span: 在 epoch 15 左右达到 0.95 左右
errors.evidence: The blue line (Train) is at approximately 0.87 at epoch 15, not 0.95. Its peak value is only slightly above 0.9.

errors.text_span: 之后逐渐趋于稳定在 0.97 左右
errors.evidence: The blue line (Train) stabilizes at a value just above 0.9, around 0.91-0.92. It never reaches 0.97.

errors.text_span: 红色曲线从 0.2 左右开始
errors.evidence: The orange line (Valid) starts at an accuracy value well below 0.1, close to 0.05, not 0.2.

errors.text_span: 在 epoch 10 处开始急剧上升
errors.evidence: The sharpest increase for the orange line (Valid) occurs before epoch 10. By epoch 10, the rate of increase has already started to slow down.

errors.text_span: 在 epoch 25 左右趋于稳定在 0.83 左右
errors.evidence: The orange line (Valid) stabilizes earlier, around epoch 22, and at a value closer to 0.85, not 0.83.
